svg.desc: Editable source for the About Time clock face (no hands). Numerals render via @font-face Jotter; regenerate the no-font production SVG with: uv run python3 scripts/utils/svg_text_to_path.py --input extracted/About\ Time/svgs/source/clock-face.svg --font extracted/About\ Time/svgs/source/jotter-primary.ttf --output ReferenceWebFiles/activities/about-time/pictures/clock-face.svg
